text_block_list.text: Autsch... I got careless.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It's my fault for being so inattentive... I
should
have been more thorough with
my warm-up
exercises...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
At this rate, my next race may be in
jeopardy...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
There's no need to rush. Just take the time to
recover.
We can still make it if we try.

text_block_list.text:
But if I do nothing but rest, my body
condition
will steadily decline.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll be fine if I only do a little bit
of
training...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I suppose...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: You're right.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will rest now so I can recover more
quickly.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Right... I mustn't give up so easily.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's adjust my schedule to focus on
light
workouts and stretching for now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I can still continue training if we do that.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: There is no need to worry. Obser—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ngh! Ouch...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
With things as they are, we should make
a
practice schedule that takes my injury
into full
consideration.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
First, we must reconsider my diet and
sleep
schedule. After that, we'll have to
put together
some easy workouts...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Visualization training would also be a
valuable
tool for conditioning my mind.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's put a new schedule together
right
away.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш looks disheartened as she
commits
herself to resting quietly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After sticking to her light training
regimen, Eishin
Flash manages to make a
full recovery!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Moving so quickly made her injury even
worse.
Full recovery is going to take a
while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
